title: Reorganizing the RNA polymerase II complex for replication of an infectious noncoding RNA in vivo.
authors: Hao, Jie; Qin, Zhuan; Ma, Junfei; Qu, Jie; Wang, Yunhan; Folimonova, Svetlana Y; Liu, Bin; Li, Wenwei; Wang, Ying
journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究RNA聚合酶II在体内重组后以RNA为模板转录类病毒RNA，涉及TFIIIA-7ZF与RNA的互作及AlphaFold3结构预测，虽非TF-DNA体系，但蛋白-核酸互作建模方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: DNA-dependent RNA polymerases (DdRPs) recognize not only DNA but also RNA templates. This RNA-dependent RNA polymerase (RdRP) activity is exploited by viroids in plants and human hepatitis delta virus in animals. A major knowledge gap exists regarding the molecular basis conferring this RdRP activity. Here, we provide evidence supporting the reorganization of the 12-subunit Pol II to 7-subunit in vivo for PSTVd transcription. Rpb4, Rpb5, Rpb6, Rpb7, and Rpb9 are not involved in PSTVd transcription in planta . A splicing variant of transcription factor IIIA with seven zinc finger domains (TFIIIA-7ZF) aids the remodeled Pol II in transcribing PSTVd. Using AlphaFold3, the structure of the remodeled Pol II with PSTVd RNA and TFIIIA-7ZF was generated. The predicted structure and experimental data both show that the N-terminus of TFIIIA-7ZF binds to the left terminal domain of PSTVd, while the C-terminus interacts with Rpb2. Interestingly, AlphaFold3 also predicts the bending at PSTVd loop 8 in the TFIIIA-7ZF/PSTVd complex. Replacing this loop 8 with a rigid double-stranded conformation impairs the TFIIIA-7ZF/PSTVd interaction. Altogether, our demonstrate an active form of heterogenous organization of the essential Pol II enzyme in vivo and provide structural insights into the organization of Pol II transcription complex on RNA template.
abstract_zh: DNA依赖性RNA聚合酶（DdRPs）不仅识别DNA，还识别RNA模板。这种RNA依赖性RNA聚合酶（RdRP）活性被植物中的类病毒和动物中的人类丁型肝炎病毒所利用。关于赋予这种RdRP活性的分子基础，目前存在重大知识空白。在此，我们提供证据支持体内12亚基Pol II重组为7亚基以进行PSTVd转录。Rpb4、Rpb5、Rpb6、Rpb7和Rpb9不参与植物体内PSTVd转录。具有七个锌指结构域的转录因子IIIA剪接变体（TFIIIA-7ZF）辅助重塑后的Pol II转录PSTVd。利用AlphaFold3，生成了重塑后Pol II与PSTVd RNA及TFIIIA-7ZF复合物的结构。预测结构和实验数据均显示，TFIIIA-7ZF的N端结合PSTVd的左末端结构域，而C端与Rpb2相互作用。有趣的是，AlphaFold3还预测了TFIIIA-7ZF/PSTVd复合物中PSTVd环8处的弯曲。将该环8替换为刚性双链构象会损害TFIIIA-7ZF/PSTVd相互作用。总之，我们的研究证明了体内必需Pol II酶异质组织的活性形式，并为RNA模板上Pol II转录复合物的组织提供了结构见解。
